title: Here are my predictions for Monday (01/05/26)
summary: There will be a post asking if MU can go higher.There will be a post mentioning that the valuations are ridiculously high and that we are, in fact, in a bubble of epic bubbly proportions.There will be a post where the user is going to be quite confused and distraught. About the current valuation of TSLA. Because it simply makes no sense. The confusion will be so palpable that one may wonder why the user didn't just use chatgpt or Gemini to answer the question quicker. In turn showing that perhaps LLMs are, in fact, a bubble. Because while the user had access to a quick answer, they chose not to use it. Stupid circular money.There seems to be an uptick in the number of posts about Satya Nadella talking about AI slop.
